name: ping-when-ready
description: Notify when a Copilot agent finishes a response in VS Code.

pingWhenReady.notifications.macOS.description: Show a native macOS Notification Center banner when a Copilot agent finishes a turn.

pingWhenReady.notifications.sound.description: Play the selected WAV or MP3 sound when a Copilot agent finishes a turn.

pingWhenReady.soundFile.description: Absolute path to a WAV or MP3 notification sound on this Mac.

pingWhenReady.notifications.iMessage.description: Run the configured macOS Shortcut when a Copilot agent finishes a turn. Configure the recipient and message in the Shortcut.

pingWhenReady.iMessage.shortcutName.description: Name of the user-created macOS Shortcut that sends the iMessage.
